before.definition: Surface biome of highest natural block; solid excludes air/water/lava. Raw gap proxy: any air above sea at least six below top, including enclosed caves. Sky-connected overhangs additionally require a six-neighbour air path to Y319 inside the chunk; paths crossing chunk faces are not followed, so frequency is a lower bound. Profiles aggregate per biome, never require matching positions. Bands match unchanged census.
